Language Study

You have seen last year that there are four types of sentences - statements,
questions, commands and exclamations. Some sentences contain negative words
like not, no, never and have a negative meaning.

e Can you turn the following commands / orders into negative ones?
Example : Put all the ingredients together.
Negative : Don’t put all the ingredients together.

e Fold the paper in half again. అఆ Wash the guava.
e Mix the ingredients. e Grind them in a mixer.

e Can you turn the following negative statements into positive (affirmative) ones?
Example : I cannot understand.

Positive : I can understand.
e I do not like that music at my dinner.
e The other did not know what to do. (Use ‘knew’.)
e Travelling from China to India was not an easy task.
e It made no difference to us. (Use ‘a difference’)

e Never trust a friend who deserts you at a pinch.

e Can you make the statements positive without changing the meaning?
What do you have to do? Can all the above sentences be rewritten in this way ?
Discuss. Write down any two sentences you could rewrite without changing
the meaning.

Two minutes of Oral Work

Think of as many commands as possible within two
minutes, that begin with the following verbs.

e cross e help e wash e study e take

Two minutes of Oral Work

Think of as many negative words as possible
within two minutes.

Example - no one.
